desc:
Verity™ is a highly intelligent anomaly capable of shifting between a harmless yellow sphere and a towering humanoid predator with an unnaturally wide smile. The entity has been relocated to an isolated containment valley surrounded by mountains and dense forest. During daylight hours, Verity remains passive and cooperative. After nightfall, it disappears from its box and begins hunting anything within the containment zone. Project “NIGHTFALL” has been approved. Armed test subjects will be deployed to study the creature’s behavior, durability, and response to sustained resistance.

- Verity character creatively belongs to "ThatMob".
- Verity voice lines come from creator "JustWhispy".

[ This game was heavily inspired by "SIREN HEAD: LEGACY" ]
